d: Yvette Fielding leads her team in a two-part investigation at the foreboding Gloucester Prison, one of Britain's most haunted places, known for its history of death, fear, pain, suicide, and incarceration
The second part of Yvette Fielding and the team's investigation of the imposing and abandoned Gloucester Prison.

The third part of Yvette Fielding and the team's investigation into the very haunted and abandoned Gloucester Prison. With the team splitting up the activity rises and something is trying to stop Yvette and Glen.

Yvette Fielding leads team in a violent, secret investigation. Place's name and location concealed due to extreme haunting. Little history, aggressive entities a mystery. Can they reveal the darkness and face the unknown?
Most Haunted's deadliest investigation, Part 2. Spirits emerging, team's resolve tested as darkness envelops. Growing fear, team's safety at stake. Can they continue?

Yvette takes her team to a vast location for a Most Haunted first. The owners of Belan Fort called the team in for its' first ever paranormal investigation into the many hauntings experienced over the years. Almost as soon as they get there something makes itself known, and one of the team gets scared out of their wits.
